from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DebtRepaymentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of cash paid for debt repayment extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the cash flow line item (e.g., '偿还债务支付的现金')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow item; 0 if not reported or negative")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the amount (e.g., '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., '财务报告', '合并现金流量表')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    debt_repayment_records: list[DebtRepaymentRecord]
